item.title: Rallying Cry – May 31, 2026
item.description: Arsenal fans flooded the streets in celebration, Trump fast-tracked psychedelic treatments for mental health, Rafa Nadal made a stunning Roland-Garros comeback, and Paris cheered PSG’s back-to-back Champions League wins.
